title: Grass-silage chemistry and microbial indicators before and after forced aeration
citation: Williams, A.G., Hoxey, R.P., & Lowe, J.F. (1997). Changes in temperature and silo gas composition during ensiling, storage and feeding-out grass silage. Grass and Forage Science, 52(2), 176–189. DOI: 10.1111/j.1365-2494.1997.tb02348.x.
source_location: Table 4, printed p. 181 (PDF text page around 5); abstract and Methods pp. 176–177.
geography: Silsoe Research Institute, Silsoe, United Kingdom
license: No explicit reuse license identified; third-party observations are transcribed with attribution and kept reference-only.
material_scope: Tetraploid hybrid Italian/perennial ryegrass (variety Sabalan), approximately 300 g DM/kg at ensiling; two approximately 12 t bunker silos.
experimental_conditions: One bunker was compacted using 5 t tractor weights, average surface pressure 4.1 kPa (Bunker 1); the second was left to settle under its own weight (Bunker 2). Table 4 summarizes five cores per bunker, sampled 330 d after ensiling and analyzed before and after 20 d forced aeration in insulated cylinders.
data_scope: 48 mean and standard-deviation pairs transcribed from Table 4 for dry matter, water-soluble carbohydrate, lactic/acetic/butyric acids, total N, ammonia-N, pH, moulds, streptococci, bacilli and lactic acid bacteria.
limitations: This is cultivated ryegrass silage, not roadside grass or GreenHub VARTA feed.
The 20-day forced-aeration core test is not a whole-silo storage trial or a direct model of the GreenHub storage configuration.
Concentrations before and after aeration are not component inventories; no dry-matter or nutrient mass loss is inferred from their differences.

The source separately estimates 0.3% and 0.9% dry-matter loss over 120–150 d for its two bunker cases, but these model estimates are not added to this measured chemistry table or treated as GreenHub rates.
No measured time series, replicate-level values, or GreenHub-calibrated kinetic equation is provided by this transcription.
All records remain reference-only and do not activate model defaults or equations.
conversion_method: No numeric conversions applied; reported means, SDs, sample count, units and bases are transcribed from Table 4.
uncertainty: Table 4 reports mean and standard deviation for five cores per bunker and state; values are not paired individual-core changes.
